html:
Begin your adventure at An Thoi Harbor and enjoy a scenic boat cruise through the southern islands of Phu Quoc. Visit Xuong Island and Gam Ghi Island for snorkeling and swimming in crystal-clear waters surrounded by colorful coral reefs.

Lunch is served onboard, freshly prepared by the crew. The journey then continues to May Rut Trong Island, where you will stay overnight at a beachside campsite.

On the island, enjoy free time to sunbathe, swim, socialize, and relax at the beach bar. As the day comes to an end, unwind in a peaceful atmosphere while watching the sunset and enjoying a delicious barbecue dinner by the sea.

Spend the night in your private tent under the open sky and stars. The next morning, enjoy breakfast and free leisure time before gathering for lunch and returning to the mainland.

ITINERARY

DAY 1

08:15 – 08:30

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Arrive at An Thoi Harbor and board the boat to explore three islands in the south of Phu Quoc.

Xuong Island or Buom Island

Snorkeling experience.

Swim in cool, clear waters and admire vibrant coral reefs and marine life. Xuong Island is one of the most untouched islands in southern Phu Quoc.

Gam Ghi Island

Continue snorkeling.

Gam Ghi Island is home to one of the largest coral reef systems in Phu Quoc, with a wide variety of coral and marine species.

Lunch served onboard the boat.

May Rut Trong Island

Campsite and overnight stay.

Enjoy a relaxing afternoon under shaded coconut trees or participate in water activities such as kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding.

In the evening, enjoy a romantic sunset followed by a delicious barbecue dinner by the beach.

Gather around the campfire, relax in your private tent, and enjoy the soothing sounds of nature.

Overnight in a private tent on the island.

DAY 2

Enjoy breakfast and explore the island at your own pace.

12:00 – 13:00

Lunch at the island restaurant.

15:00

Board the boat and cruise back to the harbor.

17:00

Return to your hotel.

Booking is required at least one day in advance.

TOUR PRICE

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 69 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 40 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by car and boat

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Private camping tent

  • Two bottles of drinking water per guest per day

  • Fresh fruit

  • One breakfast, two lunches, and one barbecue dinner

  • Snorkeling equipment including mask, snorkel, and fins
    (Fins are not available in children’s sizes)

  • Life jackets

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

  • Fresh water shower, sunbed rental, and other service fees on the island

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • In case of weather or sea conditions, the boat captain may change the island order or snorkeling locations according to the actual situation to ensure safety.

  • Guests are advised to bring personal necessities such as towels, sunscreen, mosquito repellent, toothbrush, shampoo, soap, personal medication, spare clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

  • Steamed rice

  • Fresh fruit

Dinner Menu on the Island

  • Barbecued fish

  • Barbecued shrimp

  • Barbecued chicken

  • Fresh vegetables

  • Stir-fried noodles with seafood

  • Fresh fruit

DAY TWO

Breakfast Menu on the Island

  • Omelette

  • Sandwich

  • Fresh milk

  • Coffee

  • Black tea

  • Fresh fruit

Lunch Menu on the Island

  • Steamed or grilled shrimp

  • Braised fish in clay pot

  • Sweet and sour squid

  • Seafood hotpot

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

  • Children aged ten years and above are charged the adult price.

  • Children aged from five to nine years are charged fifty percent of the adult price.

  • Children under five years old are free of charge.

Age is determined by year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • Cancellation two days before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: fifty percent of the tour value will be charged.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

Weather-related cancellations for sea tours:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to depart, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

  • If the Port Authority allows the tour to operate and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS FOR GUESTS

What to Bring

  • Towels

  • Environmentally friendly sunscreen

  • Change of clothes and swimwear

  • Comfortable shoes or flip-flops

  • Personal necessities

  • Essential items for children, if traveling with kids

Vietlook Travel and its staff are not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

Environmental Responsibility

  • Do not throw trash into the sea. Trash bins are provided on the boat.

  • Do not leave trash on the island. Please use designated recycling bins.

Snorkeling Safety Guidelines

  • Do not touch, stand on, sit on, pull, remove, or take coral.

  • Adults must always supervise children while swimming or snorkeling.

  • Wear a life jacket at all times while snorkeling.

  • Avoid areas with strong currents.

  • Snorkel with a partner or in groups.

  • Non-swimmers should seek guidance from the tour guide.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility, wheelchair users, or those with medical conditions such as asthma, heart problems, seizures, panic attacks, lung or ear conditions, severe allergies, or epilepsy.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues that may occur during or after the tour.
